rationale: Adds a content-keyed decode and upload cache for inline encoded image bytes drawn by ImageView data URIs and SceneImage blobs. Keyed draws decode and upload once per (SHA-256 of the bytes, backend) through the existing ImageFileCache, preserving pixel output; backends without a cache draw exactly as before. Pulp continues to own this editable canvas target under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits this generic cache when that target adopts the Vellum package. No source-routing or authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Disabling the image cache rebuilds keyed inline bytes'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'ImageView data URI decodes once across Graphite paints'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Recording canvas records keyed inline bytes'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SceneImage encoded bytes decode once across Graphite paints'
